product_one_liner.value: Doxis is an AI-powered enterprise content management and intelligent content automation platform that helps organizations manage documents, extract insights, and automate document-centered workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The Doxis product page describes AI-assisted document processing, insight extraction, document management, and workflow automation as enterprise content management capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: The readable homepage navigation and footer list products, solutions, resources, and contact links but no pricing link; the contact page provides a contact form and location details rather than public prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Doxis customer success stories index explicitly identifies DHL Express and BASF as customer references. | named_customers.0: DHL Express is named as a Doxis customer success-story reference. | named_customers.1: BASF is named on the customer success-stories page and labeled a subscription customer.

employee_band.notes: The company’s about page reports more than 900 employees, outside every permitted band (the largest permitted band ends at 500), so none of the listed bands fits.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s headquarters is explicitly stated as Bonn, Germany; the city field is Bonn. | hq_country: The SER announcement excerpt directly identifies the headquarters as Bonn, Germany.

founded_year.notes: SER’s official March 2024 investment announcement directly says the company was founded in 1984.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index shows editorial categories and posts about business topics, product use, and customer stories rather than a distinct engineering blog; the indexed examples do not meet the requirement for at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Doxis AI.dp has a public documentation site with multiple platform guides and sections, including model-building and SDK documentation, meeting the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists a Full Stack AI Engineer role, and its live posting says Doxis is hiring three engineers to build AI applications and models.

model_provider.value: Doxis does not depend on a single model: many AI services use customer-hosted LLMs, and its documentation supports customer-provided OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Anthropic integrations.
model_provider.notes: The AI FAQ says Doxis uses a composable approach rather than one fixed model and that many AI services use customer-hosted LLMs; the product documentation lists OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Anthropic as optional bring-your-own providers, not as a single default provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Doxis’s certification index names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and includes the EU GDPR compliance item among its certification listings; no HIPAA or PCI DSS item appears in the cited list. | compliance_certs.0: The certification index explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The certification index explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The certification index includes the EU GDPR item in its compliance certification listings, corresponding to GDPR in the requested categories.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding inventory classifies the latest round as PE, and SER’s official announcement calls it a strategic growth investment from private-equity firm TA Associates. | funding_date: The funding inventory identifies the latest PE round as March 21, 2024, corroborated by SER’s dated announcement; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2024-03. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile characterizes the 2024 PE round as undisclosed, and the financial adviser’s deal page also labels the transaction amount undisclosed; no numeric USD amount is supported.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round is dated March 21, 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; no later round is identified in the current funding profile.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Doxis’s official careers posting is for a full-time Senior Account Executive and includes an Apply now link, so it is hiring an account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 17, 2026 Doxis Summit announcement says the company unveiled new AI innovations, including the new Ask Doxi assistant and Agent Manager and enhanced Superhuman Search; this is a major feature launch within six months of November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement names a new Chief AI Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, and VP of Sales EMEA; these appointments fall within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A SER Group GTM Automation Analyst job description visibly names 6sense, Salesforce Account Engagement, Salesloft, Clay, and Cognism as marketing, sales, or data-enrichment systems used in its workflows. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job description names 6sense as a marketing platform. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job description names Salesforce Account Engagement among the systems used for triggers and sequences. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job description names Salesloft as a system used for sales sequences. | crm_stack_signal.3: The job description names Clay among its data-enrichment tools. | crm_stack_signal.4: The job description names Cognism among its data-enrichment tools.
